content.text:
Buttons, fields, and the step row now share one height, and the type scale is down to two text sizes plus the headings.

The sign-in cards were different heights because the second card picked up the spacing meant for stacked sections. Inputs were smaller than the buttons next to them, because they inherited the label size, and outlined buttons were taller than solid ones because of the border. Those controls are all 36px with 15px text now, and the agent field lines up with Create agent.

Labels, table headers, and code use 13px. Headings are 28px, 24px, and 20px. Restart `shyd` and reload the page to pick up the stylesheet, since it is compiled into the server.
